corrections.text: I let the gentle breeze stir my unfamiliar skirt and the hair I have grown a little longer...
corrections.reason: Rows 14-16 describe the first-person narrator, Azlier, not the child. The existing English incorrectly assigns the skirt and hair to the child.

corrections.text: ...as I watch him laughing happily with the islanders among the colorful flowers.
corrections.reason: Rows 17-19 identify the narrator as watching the child, Ishlar, laugh with the islanders. The existing English drops the watching action and attaches the preceding description to him.

corrections.text: and I, who abandoned my family and the military under the pretext of caring for my younger brother,
corrections.reason: The younger brother is the narrator Azlier's brother, Ishlar. The existing English reverses that relationship by calling him Ishlar's younger sibling. Preserve the subject/relative construction completed by29-30.

uncertainties.issue: Full-scene context resolves the narrator as Azlier and the child as Ishlar. The corrections restore those source-established actors without making any gender inference from the skirt.
Ishlar is spelled according to the current character reference. This review does not normalize names.

omissions.issue: The reflective narration spans successive complete VM boxes; each box retains a grammatical continuation and no box is blank.

notes: Independent source-first review of complete VM groups and surrounding context. Full-scene context resolves Azlier as narrator and Ishlar as her younger brother. Name normalization was not run.
